worksheet.title: Pre-Store Test Worksheet
worksheet.description: Plan your marketplace test, record the results, and make a data-backed decision about what comes next.

fields.label: Test marketplace
fields.helpText: Which marketplace will you use for your first listing?

fields.label: Product listed
fields.helpText: Brief description of what you listed.

fields.label: Listing price
fields.helpText: The price you set. Check it covers all costs from Chapter 5.

fields.label: Test duration
fields.helpText: How long will you run this test before judging the results? (e.g. '3 weeks')

fields.label: Test result
fields.helpText: Fill this in after the test period.

fields.label: Units sold
fields.helpText: How many units sold during the test period?

fields.label: What you learned
fields.helpText: What did the test tell you? Buyer behaviour, questions asked, price sensitivity, anything useful.

fields.label: Your decision
fields.helpText: Based on the test results and your Founder Rules from Chapter 4.
options: Iterate and retest — adjust listing or price
